Regulation Number: 2
Regulation Title: Definitions
Chapter: CHAPTER I PRELIMINARY
Clause Number: sub_clause
Requirement Type: threshold
Requirement: Gassy seam of the first degree means a belowground coal seam where inflammable gas in general body of air does not exceed 0.1% and rate of emission of gas does not exceed 1 cubic meter per tonne of coal produced.
Responsible Role: Ventilation Officer, Manager
Responsible Entity: Mine Management/Owner
Applicability: Underground coal seams
Trigger Event: Gas measurement and classification
Frequency: other
Deadline: not_specified
Reporting Required: True
Reporting Method: other
Reporting Authority: regional_inspector
Document Required: Seam Degree Classification Record
Record Required: Air sampling and gas emission records
Required Evidence: Gas test results
Inspection Required: Yes
Inspection Frequency: Periodic gas testing
Equipment Requirement: Not specified
Hazard: Inflammable gas / explosion hazard
Risk Category: Safety
Corrective Action: Reclassify seam degree if thresholds are exceeded
Violation Condition: Gas percentage > 0.1% or emission rate > 1 m3/tonne while operating as First Degree
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Automated gas compliance monitoring requires exact thresholds for seam gassiness classification.

Required Evidence: Transmission record / receipt of notice
Inspection Required: Yes

Equipment Requirement: Not specified

Regulation Number: 32

Chapter: CHAPTER IV

regulation_title: Appointment of officials and competent persons
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 35
Regulation Title: Appointment of officials and competent persons
Chapter: CHAPTER IV
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: compliance
Requirement: Where the mine is worked on more than one shift, during the afternoon shift and night shift, the mine shall be under general supervision of at least an assistant manager, and of an experienced overman in other cases.

regulation_title: Appointment of officials and competent persons
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 35
Regulation Title: Appointment of officials and competent persons
Chapter: CHAPTER IV
Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: Copies of all appointments made under sub-regulation (1) shall be entered in a bound-paged book kept for the purpose where a list of all such competent persons shall be maintained.

Regulation Number: 37
Regulation Title: Duties and responsibilities of owner
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: The owner shall arrange for regular assessment of risk and deal with it in priority order: (a) eliminate risk, (b) control at source, (c) minimize risk via safe work system design, (d) provide PPE at no cost.

Hazard: All workplace safety and health hazards
Risk Category: Safety Management
Corrective Action: Apply risk elimination/control hierarchy
Violation Condition: Failure to perform regular risk assessments or follow statutory priority order of risk controls
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Core safety risk management framework for AI compliance and risk engine.

Regulation Number: 37
Regulation Title: Duties and responsibilities of owner
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause

Relevance Reason: Critical emergency compliance tracking.

Regulation Number: 37
Regulation Title: Duties and responsibilities of owner
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: worker
Requirement: The owner shall ensure that a system is established so that the names of all persons who are employed belowground can be accurately known at any time, as well as their probable location.

Regulation Number: 39
Regulation Title: Responsibilities of contractor
Chapter: CHAPTER V

regulation_title: Duties of person employed in mines
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 40
Regulation Title: Duties of person employed in mines
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: worker
Requirement: Every person shall immediately before proceeding to work and immediately after terminating work at the end of his shift, have his name recorded in the attendance register, and in belowground workings, every time he proceeds belowground or returns to surface.
Responsible Role: worker
Responsible Entity: Mine Personnel
Applicability: All persons employed in mines
Trigger Event: Entry and exit of mine / shift start and end
Frequency: shift_based
Deadline: immediate

Risk Category: Compliance & Safety
Corrective Action: Not specified

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Worker attendance and electronic tracking compliance.

Regulation Number: 43
Regulation Title: Duties and responsibilities of manager
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: inspection
Requirement: The manager shall exercise daily personal supervision. In belowground workings, he shall visit and examine workings on at least 4 days in every week, with at least one visit every fortnight made during the night shift.
Responsible Role: manager
Responsible Entity: Mine Manager
Applicability: Belowground coal mines
Trigger Event: Not Specified

Violation Condition: Manager visiting belowground less than 4 days a week or failing night shift visit once a fortnight
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Core managerial inspection metric for regulatory compliance monitoring.

Regulation Number: 43
Regulation Title: Duties and responsibilities of manager
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: accident_reporting
Requirement: Upon occurrence of an accident resulting in serious bodily injury or loss of life, or dangerous occurrence, the manager shall inspect the site, conduct an inquiry, record results in a bound paged book with plan/photos, and furnish copy to Chief Inspector and Regional Inspector within 15 days.

Responsible Entity: Mine Manager
Applicability: Accidents causing serious injury/death or dangerous occurrences
Trigger Event: Serious bodily injury, fatal accident, or dangerous occurrence
Frequency: event_based

Record Required: Bound paged accident inquiry register
Required Evidence: Report submission receipt within 15 days

Inspection Frequency: Immediate post-accident inspection
Equipment Requirement: Not specified
Hazard: Accidents, fatalities, dangerous occurrences
Risk Category: Accident Investigation
Corrective Action: Conduct inquiry, record plan/sections/photos, submit to inspectors within 15 days
Violation Condition: Failure to inspect accident site, conduct inquiry, or furnish copy to Chief/Regional Inspector within 15 days
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Strict statutory accident reporting timeline for governance monitoring.

Regulation Number: 44
Regulation Title: Duties of safety officer
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: The safety officer shall maintain in a bound paged book a detailed record of the work performed by him every day.

Corrective Action: Not specified

Relevance Reason: Daily statutory record-keeping compliance for Safety Officers.

Regulation Number: 46
Regulation Title: Duties of ventilation officer
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: The ventilation officer shall check the speed of main mechanical ventilator, amperage drawn by electric motor, and fan drift water gauge at least once in a day, investigate any unusual change, and report to manager.
Responsible Role: ventilation officer
Responsible Entity: Ventilation

Frequency: other

Inspection Required: Yes

Risk Category: Ventilation Safety

Violation Condition: Failure to inspect main ventilator parameters daily or report abnormal readings
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Daily critical safety monitoring for mine ventilation systems.

Regulation Number: 46
Regulation Title: Duties of ventilation officer
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: inspection
Requirement: The ventilation officer shall determine the efficiency of the main mechanical ventilator once at least in every three months and get fan blades and fan drift cleaned when necessary.

Deadline: other

Inspection Required: Yes

Equipment Requirement: Main mechanical ventilator
Hazard: Reduced ventilation efficiency, airborne hazards
Risk Category: Ventilation Maintenance
Corrective Action: Clean fan blades and fan drift
Violation Condition: Failure to perform main fan efficiency determination at least once every 3 months
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Periodic maintenance and efficiency inspection requirement for safety critical machinery.

Regulation Number: 46
Regulation Title: Duties of ventilation officer
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause

Relevance Reason: Time-sensitive environmental monitoring and gas analysis requirement.

Regulation Number: 46
Regulation Title: Duties of ventilation officer
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: The ventilation officer shall take steps for cleaning, treatment, and suppression of coal dust, ensuring wet-cutting at faces and water spraying at and within ninety meters of working places are installed and operating satisfactorily.

Responsible Entity: Ventilation

Deadline: not_specified

Corrective Action: Repair or install water spraying systems within 90m zone immediately
Violation Condition: Working without operational water spraying within 90 metres of working places or defective wet-cutting
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Clear numerical spatial compliance parameter (90m water spraying zone).

Regulation Number: 48
Regulation Title: Duties and responsibilities of sirdar
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: safety
Requirement: Where working place height measured from floor to roof exceeds 3 metres, the sirdar shall see that a suitable wooden bunton/pole (to test roof) and a ladder of suitable length are kept at convenient places.

Responsible Entity: Other

Frequency: continuous
Deadline: not_specified

Record Required: Not specified

Inspection Required: Yes
Inspection Frequency: Each shift during district inspection

Risk Category: Strata Control Safety
Corrective Action: Provide bunton pole and ladder immediately in workings exceeding 3m height
Violation Condition: Failure to keep testing bunton/pole or ladder in working places exceeding 3m height
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Numerical threshold parameter for roof testing equipment requirement.

Regulation Number: 48
Regulation Title: Duties and responsibilities of sirdar
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: inspection
Requirement: Where either of two egress ways from district to surface is not ordinarily used for travelling, the sirdar shall travel the whole of such roadway once at least in every 7 days to acquaint himself with it.

Responsible Entity: Other

Frequency: weekly

Reporting Required: False

Reporting Authority: not_specified

Inspection Required: Yes
Inspection Frequency: Every 7 days
Equipment Requirement: Not specified

Risk Category: Emergency Egress Safety

Violation Condition: Failure of sirdar to travel unused egress route at least once in 7 days

Relevance Reason: Periodic inspection requirement for emergency egress routes.

regulation_title: Duties of attendant of main mechanical ventilator
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 51
Regulation Title: Duties of attendant of main mechanical ventilator
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: The attendant of main mechanical ventilator shall examine machinery and observe pressure-recording/water gauge and speed indicator at intervals of not more than one hour, entering readings in a bound paged book.
Responsible Role: attendant of main mechanical ventilator
Responsible Entity: Other
Applicability: Main mechanical ventilator fan-house
Trigger Event: Not Specified
Frequency: other
Deadline: other
Reporting Required: False
Reporting Method: not_specified
Reporting Authority: not_specified

Risk Category: Equipment & Ventilation Monitoring

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Strict hourly monitoring frequency for critical mine ventilation equipment.

Regulation Number: 53
Regulation Title: Duties and responsibilities of surveyor
Chapter: CHAPTER V
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: record
Requirement: The surveyor shall record full facts in a bound paged book when mine workings have approached to about 120 metres from the mine boundary, disused, or waterlogged workings.

Responsible Entity: Other
Applicability: Mine workings approaching boundary or disused/waterlogged areas within 120m

Frequency: other

Reporting Required: False

Reporting Authority: not_specified

Violation Condition: Failure to record proximity when workings approach within 120m of boundary or waterlogged workings
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Numerical threshold trigger for inundation and boundary safety compliance.

Regulation Number: 56
Regulation Title: Duties of banksman and onsetter

Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: After any stoppage of winding for repairs or any other cause exceeding two hours, the banksman/onsetter shall not allow any person to ride in the cage unless it has been run at least one complete trip up and down the working portion of shaft.

Risk Category: Winding Safety

Violation Condition: Permitting persons to ride in cage after > 2 hours stoppage without performing test run

Relevance Reason: Mandatory safety test protocol following winding equipment downtime.

Record Required: Not specified

Clause Number: other

Risk Category: HIGH

regulation_title: Duties of truck, tipper and dumper operator
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 63
Regulation Title: Duties of truck, tipper and dumper operator
Chapter: V
Clause Number: multiple_clauses
Requirement Type: safety
Requirement: The driver shall ensure vehicle is not overloaded, material does not project horizontally beyond body, any front/rear projection is marked with red flag (day) / red light (night), and no unauthorized person rides on the vehicle.

Relevance Reason: Controls vehicle loading limits, projection markings, and unauthorized passengers

Regulation Number: 64
Regulation Title: General requirements about mine plans
Chapter: VI
Clause Number: other
Requirement Type: document
Requirement: Every mine plan or section prepared shall specify mine/owner name and purpose, show true/magnetic north and date, include a scale bar at least 25 cm long, use a Representative Factor of 2000:1 or 1000:1 (unless approved otherwise by Chief Inspector), be inked on durable paper, tracing cloth, or polyester film, and contain an abstract of statutory restrictions.

Responsible Entity: Mine Management/Owner
Applicability: All statutory mine plans and sections
Trigger Event: Preparation of mine plans/sections

Risk Category: MEDIUM

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Fundamental standards for mine plan drafting and scaling

Regulation Number: 64
Regulation Title: General requirements about mine plans
Chapter: VI
Clause Number: other
Requirement Type: document
Requirement: Plans and sections required under these regulations shall be maintained corrected up-to-date within a period not earlier than three months, provided that before abandonment, closure, or discontinuance, they shall be brought fully up-to-date.

Risk Category: HIGH

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Statutory quarterly plan update cycle requirement

Regulation Number: 64
Regulation Title: General requirements about mine plans
Chapter: VI
Clause Number: other

Requirement: Plans and sections maintained under regulations shall be kept available for inspection in the office at the mine, and shall not be removed except by or with written approval of the Regional Inspector unless a true copy is retained.

Regulation Number: 65
Regulation Title: Type of plans
Chapter: VI
Clause Number: other
Requirement Type: document
Requirement: The owner, agent or manager shall maintain specific statutory plans: surface plan, underground plan (showing features within 200m), vertical mine sections (for inclination > 30 deg or opencast <=100m intervals), ventilation plan, joint survey plan (workings within 60m of boundary), geological plan, and water-danger plan/section (water bodies within 200m, water sources within 60m).

Regulation Number: 65
Regulation Title: Type of plans
Chapter: VI
Clause Number: multiple_clauses

Requirement: Plans shall show surface contours at vertical intervals <= 5m (or 10m for surface-only/hilly terrain) within 200m of workings; floor spot levels on haulages/junctions (<=150m for manual tramming) and discontinued heading ends; and establish a permanent surface bench-mark tied to Mean Sea Level.

Relevance Reason: Technical surveying requirements for elevations and contouring

Regulation Number: 65
Regulation Title: Type of plans
Chapter: VI
Clause Number: multiple_clauses
Requirement Type: reporting
Requirement: Plans shall show workings of adjacent mines within 60 meters of boundary. When workings extend within 60 meters of settled or disputed boundary, the owner, agent, or manager shall inform the adjacent mine manager and provide reasonable survey facilities.

Inspection Required: Yes

Equipment Requirement: Not specified
Hazard: Boundary encroachment, illegal mining, unintended connection into old workings
Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Notify adjacent mine immediately when workings come within 60m of boundary and allow survey access

regulation_title: Plans and sections to be submitted after abandonment, closure or discontinuance
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 66
Regulation Title: Plans and sections to be submitted after abandonment, closure or discontinuance
Chapter: VI
Clause Number: multiple_clauses
Requirement Type: reporting
Requirement: Where a mine/seam is abandoned/closed or discontinued > 60 days, the owner at that time shall submit 2 true up-to-date plan/section copies to Chief Inspector within 30 days (abandonment/closure) or 90 days (discontinuance), showing bearings/distances to permanent features, water dams, and spot levels, and retain original/certified copy in mine office.
Responsible Role: owner
Responsible Entity: Mine Management/Owner

Reporting Required: True
Reporting Method: plan_submission
Reporting Authority: chief_inspector
Document Required: Abandoned/Closed Mine Up-to-Date Plans & Sections (2 copies)
Record Required: Original or certified true copy kept in mine office
Required Evidence: DGMS submission receipt
Inspection Required: Yes
Inspection Frequency: Post-closure verification
Equipment Requirement: Not specified
Hazard: Uncharted abandoned workings creating future inundation/collapse risk
Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Submit 2 copies of up-to-date plans within 30 days of closure or 90 days of discontinuance

Relevance Reason: Statutory submission requirement for abandoned mine plans

Regulation Number: 67
Regulation Title: Survey instruments and materials

Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Provide calibrated instruments; maintain regular manufacturer calibration

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Mandatory survey equipment calibration requirement

regulation_title: List of plans, sections and instruments and their storage
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 68
Regulation Title: List of plans, sections and instruments and their storage
Chapter: VI
Clause Number: multiple_clauses
Requirement Type: record
Requirement: All plans/sections shall be serially numbered and stored flat. Field books/notes shall be indexed and kept in mine office. A list of all plans, survey instruments (with types, specs, serial numbers), and field books shall be kept in a bound-paged book, updated, signed/dated by surveyor, and countersigned/dated by manager.

Risk Category: HIGH

Relevance Reason: Personal liability and signature endorsement standards for mine surveyors

regulation_title: Plans to be checked on change of ownership or on reopening, etc.
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 70
Regulation Title: Plans to be checked on change of ownership or on reopening, etc.
Chapter: VI
Clause Number: multiple_clauses
Requirement Type: compliance
Requirement: On ownership change, reopening, or before pillar extraction/reduction, management shall ensure plans are accurate (prepare fresh if in doubt). Regional Inspector may order fresh survey/plans if inaccurate, and if defaulted, get it done at owner's expense as land revenue arrears.

Record Required: Survey verification records
Required Evidence: Fresh survey report and updated plans
Inspection Required: Yes
Inspection Frequency: Before reopening/pillar extraction
Equipment Requirement: Not specified
Hazard: Collapse or inundation during depillaring due to inaccurate old plans
Risk Category: HIGH

Violation Condition: Commencing pillar extraction or reopening mine with doubtful/unverified plans
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Mandatory plan verification prior to high-risk mining phases like depillaring

Regulation Title: Outlets from a mine
Chapter: VII
Clause Number: multiple_clauses
Requirement Type: safety
Requirement: Belowground workings shall have at least two shafts, inclines or outlets communicating with every working seam to afford separate ingress/egress, not in the same building, under sole control of manager. Mechanical winding is required if shaft > 30m depth, and an approved man-riding system if incline > 1 km long or travel is arduous.

Responsible Entity: Mine Management/Owner
Applicability: All underground mine workings
Trigger Event: Underground mining operations
Frequency: continuous
Deadline: not_specified
Reporting Required: False
Reporting Method: not_specified
Reporting Authority: chief_inspector
Document Required: Approved Man-riding Scheme (if applicable)
Record Required: Outlet specifications
Required Evidence: Two functional independent outlets
Inspection Required: Yes
Inspection Frequency: Weekly examination
Equipment Requirement: Mechanical winding (>30m shaft), Approved Man-riding System (>1km incline)
Hazard: Trapped underground miners during shaft/incline damage
Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Provide 2 independent outlets; install mechanical winding (>30m shaft) or approved man-riding (>1km incline)
Violation Condition: Employing persons underground with only one outlet or lacking required mechanical/man-riding means
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Fundamental underground safety rule requiring two independent egress outlets

Responsible Entity: Mine Management/Owner
Applicability: Shaft ladderways and underground outlet connections
Trigger Event: Shaft/incline outlet construction and maintenance
Frequency: continuous
Deadline: not_specified
Reporting Required: False
Reporting Method: not_specified
Reporting Authority: not_specified
Document Required: Not specified
Record Required: Not specified

Inspection Required: Yes
Inspection Frequency: Weekly
Equipment Requirement: Shaft ladders, resting platforms
Hazard: Falls from ladders, restricted evacuation passage between outlets
Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Maintain ladder inclination <=80 deg, platforms <=9m, outlet distance >=13.5m, passage >=1.8m x 1.5m
Violation Condition: Ladders >80 deg, platforms >9m apart, outlets <13.5m apart, or passage <1.8m high / <1.5m wide

Clause Number: multiple_clauses

Responsible Entity: Mine Management/Owner

Frequency: continuous
Deadline: not_specified
Reporting Required: False
Reporting Method: not_specified
Reporting Authority: chief_inspector
Document Required: Communication System Approval Letter
Record Required: Telecommunication system log
Required Evidence: Functional two-way broadcasting telecommunication system

Equipment Requirement: Approved two-way telecommunication and broadcasting system
Hazard: Inability to communicate emergency messages between underground and surface
Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Install and maintain Chief Inspector approved two-way communication and broadcast system in outlets
Violation Condition: Lack of functional two-way communication system in access/egress outlets
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Mandatory telecommunication system in mine access and egress routes

Clause Number: multiple_clauses

Deadline: not_specified

Reporting Method: not_specified
Reporting Authority: regional_inspector
Document Required: Not specified
Record Required: Not specified

Risk Category: HIGH

Violation Condition: Sinking shaft lining >6m (or >20m with rings) from bottom, unilluminated entrances, loose debris at shaft top/sump

Reporting Authority: not_specified

Risk Category: HIGH

Relevance Reason: Physical fencing and gate security standard at mine outlets

Regulation Number: 78
Regulation Title: Construction and installation of winding equipment
Chapter: VIII
Clause Number: multiple_clauses
Requirement Type: equipment
Requirement: Winding equipment/headgear must be sound, rigid-founded, fleet angle <= 1.5 degrees, drum/pulley diameter >= 80x rope diameter (if installed before Oct 25, 1955) or >= 100x rope diameter (others), with matching grooves and pulleys rotating in vertical plane without slipping.

Responsible Entity: Mine Management/Owner

Inspection Frequency: Periodic technical audit

Relevance Reason: Engineering specifications for winding drums, sheaves, and fleet angle

Requirement: Winding engines require drum flanges; secure rope fixation (except friction winder); >= 2 turns of rope on drum at lowest point; brakes holding max torque (at least 1 fail-safe 'on', power brakes auto-applied on power failure); no screw stop-valve control for steam/air; depth indicator & auto warning bell at >= 2 drum revolutions from top (tested after rope adjustments).

Reporting Method: not_specified
Reporting Authority: not_specified

Record Required: Depth indicator test log
Required Evidence: Functional fail-safe brakes, depth indicator, and warning bell
Inspection Required: Yes
Inspection Frequency: Daily / After rope adjustment
Equipment Requirement: Drum flanges, fail-safe brakes, depth indicator, warning bell (2 revs)
Hazard: Overwinding, brake failure on power loss, rope slip off drum
Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Maintain fail-safe brakes, 2 turns on drum, and tested depth indicator with warning bell
Violation Condition: < 2 turns of rope on drum at lowest point, un-automated fail-safe brakes, or non-functional depth indicator bell
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Mandatory safety fittings (brakes, depth indicator, warning bell) on winding engines

Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Maintain dual signaling and 2-way comms; enforce standard signal codes
Violation Condition: Using unauthorized signals, lack of 2-way comms, or unposted signal code

Relevance Reason: Shaft signaling code standard and mandatory 2-way telecommunication requirement

Relevance Reason: Mechanical safety fittings for shafts (keps, guides, protective roofing)

Chapter: IX - HAULAGE

Regulation Number: 97

Chapter: IX - HAULAGE

Requirement: Adequate automatic protection shall be provided on belt conveyors to ensure automatic stopping in case of: (a) excessive friction between belt and drums/rollers/scrappers; (b) belt breakage; (c) fire or heating in conveyor or vicinity.

Regulation Number: 98

Requirement: Competent person shall examine: (a) every 24 hours, every haulage engine, brake-wheel, rope, and appliances in use; (b) every 7 days, every track with mechanical/gravity haulage and fitted safety contrivances. Results recorded in bound paged book.

regulation_title: Examination of haulage and travelling roadways
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 99
Regulation Title: Examination of haulage and travelling roadways
Chapter: IX - HAULAGE
Clause Number: other
Requirement Type: inspection
Requirement: Overman or other competent person shall examine carefully, once at least in every 7 days, the state of all haulage and travelling roads/roadways (including outlet roads in use), and record signed/dated report in bound paged book.

Responsible Entity: Unknown

Regulation Number: 100
Regulation Title: Locomotives
Chapter: IX - HAULAGE
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: threshold
Requirement: No locomotive shall be used underground where the gradient of the track exceeds one in fifteen (1 in 15).

Responsible Entity: Unknown

Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Not specified

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Specific track gradient limit for locomotive safety.

Regulation Number: 102
Regulation Title: Movement of wagons
Chapter: IX - HAULAGE
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: threshold
Requirement: No material shall be placed or dumped within 1.2 meters from either side of a track of rails.
Responsible Role: manager, siding_incharge, worker
Responsible Entity: Unknown

Regulation Number: 103
Regulation Title: Fencings and gates
Chapter: IX - HAULAGE
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: threshold
Requirement: Where occupied buildings are situated within 15 meters of any haulage road, tramline, rail line or haul road, a substantial fence shall be provided and maintained between buildings and road/line.
Responsible Role: manager, owner
Responsible Entity: Unknown

Regulation Number: 104
Regulation Title: Safety management plan
Chapter: X - MINE WORKING
Clause Number: other
Requirement Type: governance
Requirement: Owner, agent and manager shall identify hazards, assess risks, consult Safety Committee and ISO, determine measures (eliminate, control at source, minimise, PPE, monitoring), and prepare an auditable document called 'Safety Management Plan' (SMP).
Responsible Role: owner, agent, manager
Responsible Entity: Mine Management/Owner
Applicability: All coal mines
Trigger Event: Mine operation

Regulation Number: 105
Regulation Title: Manual opencast working
Chapter: X - MINE WORKING
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: threshold
Requirement: In manual opencast workings in alluvial soil, morum, gravel, clay, debris: sides shall be sloped <= 45° or benched such that bench height <= 1.5 meters and bench breadth >= bench height.

Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Not specified

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Specific slope/bench dimension limits for manual opencast safety.

Regulation Number: 105
Regulation Title: Manual opencast working
Chapter: X - MINE WORKING
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: threshold
Requirement: In manual opencast workings in coal, sides shall be sloped <= 45° or benched such that bench height <= 3.0 meters and bench breadth >= bench height.

Regulation Number: 105
Regulation Title: Manual opencast working
Chapter: X - MINE WORKING
Clause Number: main_clause

Regulation Number: 106

Clause Number: other

Requirement: Before starting mechanised opencast working, owner and agent shall ensure ultimate pit slope, dump slope, and monitoring of slope stability have been planned based on scientific study report kept available at mine office. Manager shall ensure scientific recommendations are complied with.

Regulation Number: 106
Regulation Title: Mechanised opencast working
Chapter: X - MINE WORKING
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: threshold
Requirement: In mechanised opencast working in coal and rock: bench height shall NOT exceed digging height/reach of excavation machine; bench width shall NOT be less than (a) widest machine width + 2m, or (b) 3x dumper width, or (c) bench height, whichever is HIGHEST.

Responsible Entity: Unknown

Equipment Requirement: Not specified

Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Not specified

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Crucial machine-dependent geometric formula for bench safety.

Regulation Number: 108
Regulation Title: Spoil-banks and dumps
Chapter: X - MINE WORKING
Clause Number: multiple_clauses
Requirement Type: threshold
Requirement: Spoil bank parameters: slope <= 37.5° from horizontal (unless steeper slope recommended by scientific study); if height > 30m, must be benched so no bench exceeds 30m height and overall slope <= 1 vertical to 1.5 horizontal; toe shall NOT extend within 100m of mine opening, railway, public road/works, or permanent building.

Responsible Entity: Unknown

Reporting Authority: not_specified

Record Required: Dump monitoring logs
Required Evidence: Survey plans of spoil bank
Inspection Required: Yes
Inspection Frequency: Not specified
Equipment Requirement: Not specified
Hazard: Dump slide engulfing public roads, structures, or mine openings
Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Not specified
Violation Condition: Spoil slope > 37.5°, unbenched height > 30m, overall slope steeper than 1:1.5, or toe within 100m of public road/railway/building
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Multiple critical numerical thresholds for spoil dump stability and safety setback.

Regulation Number: 109
Regulation Title: Transport rules
Chapter: X - MINE WORKING
Clause Number: other

Requirement: Manager shall frame and enforce a code of transport rules based on transportation machinery size/capacity and local conditions, submit a copy to Regional Inspector, and hand over copies to operators/drivers/officials and post copies in comprehensible languages at conspicuous places.

Risk Category: HIGH

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Statutory rule creation and driver compliance tracking.

Regulation Title: Codes of practice

Clause Number: other

Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Not specified

Relevance Reason: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) mandatory framing rule.

Regulation Number: 111
Regulation Title: Development work
Chapter: X - MINE WORKING
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: threshold
Requirement: Save with previous written permission of Regional Inspector, no gallery in a seam or section shall exceed 3.0 meters in height or 4.8 meters in width at any place.

Deadline: not_specified

Reporting Method: written_notification
Reporting Authority: chief_inspector

Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: For mine workings made prior to 7th September 1926, during pillar extraction or reduction, if center distance is smaller than specified table, pillars shall not be further reduced; if not smaller, distance shall not be rendered smaller than specified or required by Chief Inspector; gallery height and width shall not be increased without written permission of Regional Inspector.

Deadline: not_specified

Reporting Authority: regional_inspector
Document Required: Written permission from Regional Inspector for gallery dimension increase
Record Required: Not specified

Inspection Required: Not specified
Inspection Frequency: Not specified
Equipment Requirement: Not specified
Hazard: Pillar crushing, premature collapse
Risk Category: HIGH

Risk Category: HIGH

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Inspectorate authority to mandate dimensional changes to avert collapse.

Regulation Title: Depillaring operations

regulation_title: Extraction of Coal by method other than bord and pillar system

Regulation Number: 115
Regulation Title: Roads and working places

Regulation Number: 115
Regulation Title: Roads and working places
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: reporting
Requirement: Whenever crush of pillars or any symptom of impending collapse other than ordinarily caused by pillar extraction is detected, manager shall inform Regional Inspector forthwith.

regulation_title: Pointing out of contraventions during inspections
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 117
Regulation Title: Pointing out of contraventions during inspections
Chapter: CHAPTER X

regulation_title: Pointing out of contraventions during inspections
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 117
Regulation Title: Pointing out of contraventions during inspections
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: reporting
Requirement: Owner, agent or manager shall return one copy of contravention entry with remarks showing action taken and date within a period not exceeding 15 days to Chief Inspector or Inspector.

Regulation Number: 118
Regulation Title: Multi-section and contiguous working
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: compliance
Requirement: No working shall be made in more than one section in any seam, nor shall workings be made in any two seams lying within 9 meters of each other, without prior permission in writing of Chief Inspector.

Project Relevance: HIGH

Regulation Number: 118
Regulation Title: Multi-section and contiguous working
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: threshold
Requirement: The parting left between any two seams or sections shall not be less than 3 meters in thickness at any place, unless Chief Inspector permits otherwise.

regulation_title: Working under railways and roads, etc.
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 119
Regulation Title: Working under railways and roads, etc.
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: compliance
Requirement: No working or extraction/reduction of pillars shall be conducted within 45 meters of any railway, public road, public work, building, or permanent structure not belonging to owner, without prior written permission of Chief Inspector.

regulation_title: Working near mine boundaries in belowground mines
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 121
Regulation Title: Working near mine boundaries in belowground mines
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: In belowground mines, no working shall be made within a barrier distance equal to half the distance specified in col (5) of table in reg 111(4) from mine boundary.

Relevance Reason: Critical underground boundary safety barrier regulation.

regulation_title: Working near mine boundaries in opencast mines
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 122
Regulation Title: Working near mine boundaries in opencast mines
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: In opencast mines, no working shall be made within a distance of 7.5 meters of the boundary of any mine.

Regulation Number: 123
Regulation Title: Strata Control and Monitoring Plan

Regulation Number: 123
Regulation Title: Strata Control and Monitoring Plan

Regulation Number: 124
Regulation Title: Setting of support
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: equipment
Requirement: Where a prop is set on sand or loose material, a flat base-piece not less than 5 cm in thickness, 25 cm in width, and 75 cm in length shall be used.

Corrective Action: Replace with standard base-piece immediately
Violation Condition: Using undersized base-pieces or setting props directly on loose material

Relevance Reason: Specific numerical dimensions for prop base support quality.

Regulation Title: Setting of support
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: Lid used over a prop shall have width not less than prop diameter, thickness not less than 8 cm, and length not less than 50 cm.

Violation Condition: Prop lid thickness < 8cm or length < 50cm or width < prop diameter
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Numerical threshold for prop wooden lids in roof support.

Regulation Title: Setting of support
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause

Requirement: Cogging members shall be not less than 1.2 meters in length.

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Numerical dimension standard for heavy roof support cogs.

rag_text:
Regulation Number: 126
Regulation Title: Provision of roof canopies or cabs

Violation Condition: Operating underground self-propelled machinery without approved roof canopy or cab
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Mandatory mobile equipment safety canopy requirement for underground workers.

Regulation Title: Steep working

Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Provide and enforce safety belt/lifeline immediately
Violation Condition: Working on >= 45 degree slope without safety belt or life line
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Numerical slope threshold trigger for mandatory fall protection.

Regulation Number: 128
Regulation Title: Fencings and gates
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause
Requirement Type: safety
Requirement: Where excavation formed by mining extends within 15 meters of a public road or building, substantial fencing shall be erected and maintained around excavation.

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Numerical proximity threshold for public protection fencing.

Regulation Number: 129
Regulation Title: Examination by sirdars
Chapter: CHAPTER X
Clause Number: main_clause

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Core statutory inspection cadence for mine sirdars.

Regulation Title: Working at height

regulation_title: Classification of coal seams according to their degree of gassiness
rag_text:

regulation_title: Precautions after a fire has broken out

Regulation Number: 138

Clause Number: main_clause

Risk Category: HIGH

Regulation Number: 139

Relevance Reason: Specific equipment safety threshold for heavy mining equipment fire protection.

Regulation Number: 139
Regulation Title: Equipment for fire-fighting
Chapter: CHAPTER XI

regulation_title: Apparatus for testing for carbon monoxide

Regulation Number: 142
Regulation Title: Precautions when a fire exists

regulation_title: Atmospheric condition checking behind fire stoppings
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 142
Regulation Title: Atmospheric condition checking behind fire stoppings
Chapter: XI
Clause Number: other
Requirement Type: monitoring
Requirement: In every coal seam, arrangements shall be made once at least every thirty days to ascertain the atmospheric condition behind the stoppings built to seal off old workings, goaf, fire or spontaneous heating, unless explosion-proof.

Responsible Entity: Mine Management/Owner

Deadline: not_specified

Record Required: Record of gas analysis behind stoppings
Required Evidence: Gas analysis test entries signed by competent person
Inspection Required: Yes

Hazard: Gas accumulation, explosion, leakage behind stoppings
Risk Category: HIGH
Corrective Action: Conduct immediate atmospheric analysis behind stoppings and seal leaks
Violation Condition: Failure to check atmosphere behind fire stoppings every 30 days
Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Periodic environmental monitoring requirement behind fire seals.

Regulation Number: 142
Regulation Title: Construction and maintenance of stoppings
Chapter: XI
Clause Number: other
Requirement Type: compliance
Requirement: Every stopping erected to isolate or control fire or spontaneous heating or seal goaf/old workings shall be numbered, of adequate strength, maintained leak-proof, and fitted with a suitable drainage pipe if water is likely to accumulate.

Responsible Entity: Mine Management/Owner
Applicability: All belowground isolation/fire stoppings
Trigger Event: Erection and maintenance of stoppings
Frequency: continuous
Deadline: not_specified

Risk Category: HIGH

Project Relevance: HIGH
Relevance Reason: Physical infrastructure requirement for mine isolation stoppings.

Chapter: XI
Clause Number: other

regulation_title: Inspection of fire stoppings by competent person
rag_text:

Clause Number: other

rag_text:

Clause Number: other

Relevance Reason: Audit trail and record-keeping requirement for stopping safety.

Clause Number: other

Relevance Reason: Core environmental and occupational health compliance rule for dust control.

regulation_title: Permissible limit of airborne respirable dust
rag_text:
Regulation Number: 143
Regulation Title: Permissible limit of airborne respirable dust

Clause Number: other

Hazard: Pneumoconiosis, silicosis, respiratory disease
Risk Category: CRITICAL
Corrective Action: Cease operation or improve dust control measures if limit exceeded
Violation Condition: Dust concentration exceeding 2 mg/m3 or 10/(% silica) TWA

Relevance Reason: Quantitative occupational health limit for respirable coal dust exposure.

Regulation Number: 143

Risk Category: HIGH

Relevance Reason: Mandatory monthly dust monitoring schedule.

Clause Number: other

Relevance Reason: Technical protocol for reliable environmental dust measurement.
